sources: Three user-provided Vietnamese supplement PDFs (personal copies, not uploaded to repository)
method: PyMuPDF geometry-aware text blocks and explicit item-marker/POS rules

vocabulary.issue: POS tag absent on many rows, especially later pages; parser only finds a subset; no automatic approval

kanji.issue: Headings provide Han-Viet readings, not guaranteed precise Vietnamese meanings

grammar.issue: Lesson heading count is not individual grammar-pattern count; many patterns sit inside a lesson

accuracyDefinition: A candidate is only a source position; accurate Japanese headword, reading, sense, usage, and any answer must be independently checked. These 1948 detected positions are not a verified deck.
